text:
maya-marketing: Hey @jake-runtime @priya-eng — quick favor for Friday's webinar. We need a tiny reproducibility pack and a 2-slide 'bench highlights' artifact for the launch post. Goal: make claims verifiable and give the demo team something they can run locally.

jake-runtime: sure. what exactly do you need in the pack? metrics, sample payloads, quantized variants?

maya-marketing: Prefer 'snackable' artifacts: 5 representative payloads (short, mid, long), raw timing CSV, a couple of request traces (one cold-like, one steady-state), and a one-paragraph notes file about the run conditions. We'll call out p50/p95/p99 latency and tokens/sec. Also include the int8 quantized run if it's stable.

priya-eng: Quick Q — which model + sequence length distribution should we mirror? Is this the webinar demo model (redwood-v1-like) or the larger launch claim model?

maya-marketing: Use the demo model (rwd-demo-2b) for the pack. For distribution: 50% short (<=64), 30% mid (65-512), 20% long (513-2048). We only need one long example with a 2k-ish context.

jake-runtime: Got it. Timeline: can deliver artifacts by Thu EOD if we run micro-bench sweep today. I'll produce CSV, traces, and a tarball with payloads + a README. For quantized int8, I'll run a stability quick-check; if noisy I'll still include the raw numbers and call it out.

sam-demo: Can you include a tiny runbook snippet we can paste in the demo laptop README? e.g. exact API call, flags, and an example curl.

jake-runtime: Yep — will add a /demo/run.sh snippet and the exact env vars. Example: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' -d '{"model":"rwd-demo-2b","input":"Hello"}'
```

maya-marketing: thank you. also need one-line provenance for the press: "results measured on rwd-demo-2b, quantized int8 run on dedicated-gpu-43, p95 computed over 500 requests" — we'll tweak wording but need the raw number to support that.

jake-runtime: I'll include a provenance.txt with exact infra (instance IDs, driver versions, kernel, note about batching disabled).

runtime-bot: micro-bench job #45321 queued by jake-runtime (ETA ~3h). Logs will appear in /runs/45321.

maya-marketing: perfect. if Thursday EOD looks tight, flag us early — we may re-scope to fewer payloads but keep the traces. :thumbsup:
